hero.title: Building Blocks for the Web
hero.description: Clean, modern page blocks built from Mestakara UI components. Copy and paste them into your app, then adapt. Works with every React framework.

items.dashboard-01: A dashboard with sidebar, charts and data table.
items.login-02: A two column login page with a cover image.
items.login-03: A login page with a muted background color.
items.login-04: A login page with form and image.
items.sidebar-01: A simple sidebar with navigation grouped by section.
items.sidebar-06: A sidebar with submenus as dropdowns.
items.sidebar-07: A sidebar that collapses to icons.
items.sidebar-08: An inset sidebar with secondary navigation.
items.sidebar-11: A sidebar with a collapsible file tree.
items.sidebar-16: A sidebar with a sticky site header.
items.signup-02: A two column signup page with a cover image.
items.signup-03: A signup page with a muted background color.
items.signup-04: A signup page with form and image.
items.signup-05: A simple signup form with social providers.
